fieldNotes.operator: Building at 2402 W 6th St is operated by Prairie Farms Dairy (branch 574-255-9641), confirmed by Prairie Farms / '100% REAL Dairy' reefer trailer wraps in the yard and business listings. The roster's E.A. Sween / 7-Eleven attribution does not match the tenant at this address; physical audit is of the building at the supplied rooftop coordinates.

fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere on the perimeter. No staffed structure beside the gate.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but unguarded (no booth) implies manual/keyed access rather than a manned checkpoint; marked true per rubric (gate + no guard shack).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Low count, hard to read exactly from overhead: a single drive-in overhead door on the south face (Street View) plus ~4-6 dock/door positions along the west face of the main warehouse. Banded 0-10; flagged low-confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: ~12 trailers/reefers parked across the gravel yard (west and north rows); a dedicated unpaved drop lot. Banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gate sits directly on a residential street with no stacking room; a queue would spill onto Studebaker St / W 6th St immediately.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside Mishawaka's built-up residential fabric (South Bend metro); houses directly across both bordering streets. Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: NS rail line runs along the north property edge but is a through line; no spur enters the yard.
